(2) As they interact, a cat emoji and a dog emoji appear next to the child's head at different moments. The man gestures with his hand, pointing at the child. (4) A lightbulb icon and sparkle graphics are overlaid on the screen around the boy. He breaks into a wide, charming smile. (5) In the final moments, the boy suddenly lunges forward toward the camera with his mouth wide open in a playful scream. The man's hand enters the frame from the left to gently restrain or play with him as the boy crawls away on the patterned bedding.

This is followed by the child asking a question, immediately punctuated by a stylized 'cat meow' SFX. (3) The child mentions a dog, which is instantly emphasized by a loud, high-fidelity 'dog bark' SFX. (4) As the conversation shifts to cockroaches, the audio features a sequence of comedic sound effects: a percussive impact SFX when the adult says 'mom' and a sliding whistle SFX when he says 'slipper,' followed by background laughter.
